detailZones.title: Cabinet canopy and shell
detailZones.description: Trace the visible merchandiser canopy, header, stainless frame, side panels and shell seams.

detailZones.title: Left glass-door bank
detailZones.description: Inspect the left transparent door, frame, hinge, gasket, shelf hardware and visible dairy packages.

detailZones.title: Center glass-door bank
detailZones.description: Follow the central door hardware, shelf rails, interior liner, bottle caps and dairy containers.

detailZones.title: Right egg and cheese bank
detailZones.description: Inspect the right glass door, frame, shelf hardware and distinct egg, butter and cheese packages.

detailZones.title: Shelf and product detail
detailZones.description: Compare the visible shelf edges, supports, product separators and blank dairy package forms.

detailZones.title: Base and airflow hardware
detailZones.description: Trace the visible lower base, black ventilation louvers, rails, feet and floor contact details.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 refrigerated-display-case photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 141 independently pointable cabinet, door, shelf, dairy, egg, cheese, lighting and base-airflow parts. Product brands, readable package text, prices, barcodes, temperatures, energy performance, freshness, food-safety claims and hidden refrigeration components were excluded.
